name: Sukanti Mohapatra

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sukanti Mohapatra is a bilingual poet and educator from Balasore, Odisha, writing in Odia and English. Her collection The Aurora of Dreams was published by Booksclinic Publishing in 2020. The book’s introduction connects her poetry with teaching and with a sustained hope for a more humane world; Kabita Live’s biography likewise places her work within Odisha’s English-teaching community.

Her contributions here approach that hope through different forms. “Winter” turns cold into an image of indifference, setting human suffering against the search for warmth. “MY FREEDOM” locates liberty within the spirit even under constraint. In “A Beloved Baby Blue”, the colour blue carries the poem through Krishna’s childhood, love, music and divine presence, extending into the imagery of Neelamadhava. Together, these poems move between social concern, inward resolve and devotional imagination.
